description: Publish the exact reviewed draft revision as a public personalized card without sending or scheduling email. Requires a verified account. Returns card_url, sender share_page_url and sharing_methods. Offer these options and any messaging, email or social tools available to you, then ask which method the user prefers. Share only card_url with recipients. Repeated calls return the same card. Use prepare_ecard with the current revision to edit published text while preserving its URL.
name: publish_ecard
